_about: The real instruments' sample libraries, as lemo-opuscar packs them (lossless FLAC, an index.json of every sample's pitch, velocity layer, onset and level, each library's own LICENSE/README kept), from its GitHub release. Pinned here by size and SHA-256: engine/scripts/instruments.mjs downloads them into ~/.chrishkai-video/instruments/, and engine/vendor/lemo/sampler.py plays them. credit: what the film's credits must say when an instrument of the library is used (null: CC0, nothing required).

vsco2ce.what: strings, harp, celesta, glockenspiel, timpani, brass, woodwinds (Versilian Studios, VS Chamber Orchestra Community Edition)

salamander.what: grand piano (Salamander Grand Piano V3, five of its sixteen velocity layers)

vcsl.what: more percussion and instruments (Versilian Community Sample Library)

freepats.what: drum kit (MuldjordKit), guitars, electric bass, kalimba, accordion, world percussion (FreePats)
freepats.licence: CC0 1.0; the drum kit CC BY 4.0

karoryfer.what: erhu, jazz double bass, alto sax (Karoryfer Samples)
